pages.text: NetheryX dungeons are multi-room fortresses: guards and monster spawners on the way, side rooms with chests, then the $(l)boss arena$(). The treasure room is closed by $(item)Guardian Seals$(), unbreakable blocks that only crumble when the boss dies.$(br2)A dungeon lies roughly every 300 blocks: use the $(item)Soul Compass$() to find one. Bring armor, food and a $(item)Recall Stone$()!
pages.title: Donjons

pages.text: Unbreakable. Breaks by itself when the dungeon boss is defeated.
